profile.name: Cenk Dönmez
profile.headline: Researching landscapes. Connecting evidence.
profile.introduction: I am a geospatial scientist working at the intersection of agricultural landscapes, long-term experiments and research data infrastructures. My work connects field evidence, spatial intelligence and collaborative research to support better environmental decisions.
profile.about: My research brings together GIS, remote sensing, spatial modelling and long-term field experiments to understand agricultural landscapes and make scientific evidence more useful. Alongside research, I develop data infrastructures and help coordinate international collaborations linking experiments, living labs and decision-making.
profile.role: Senior Scientist · ZALF  |  Professor · Çukurova University

posts.title: Connecting long-term experiment networks
posts.summary: At the Morrow Plots LTE Conference, I shared approaches for making experimental knowledge more discoverable and useful across Europe and the US.
posts.body: The discussion focused on the reuse of long-term data, research data management and the role of geospatial assessment in connecting evidence across networks.

posts.title: A new direction for AI-ready soil evidence
posts.summary: Scientific coordination of an international proposal connecting long-term experiments and AI-enabled soil-health decision support.
posts.body: The proposal brings together experiment networks, soil data expertise and AI research to improve the accessibility and applicability of long-term observations. Submission does not imply funding.
